originality.rationale: Full primary source comparison finds no fixed-finite-memory exact logarithmic far-tail and exponential-moment domain theorem. Near-match Goswami employs prescribed Gaussian bath distribution in a renewal approximation and gives a strong-coupling exponential limit, not invariant finite-coupling retained-bath exactness. Tal-Friedman treats proportional reset of a single coordinate. Nine completed indexed-research searches found no covering equivalent.
